use default

use ROW = (library: string, dependencies: string)

dependency_graph(rows: List[ROW]) -> MAP[string, SET[string]] is
    let graph = MAP()

    for row in rows do
        if !graph.contains_key(row.library) then
            graph[row.library] = SET()
        fi

        for name in row.dependencies.split([' ']) do
            if name.length == 0 \/ name =~ row.library then
                continue
            fi

            if !graph.contains_key(name) then
                graph[name] = SET()
            fi

            graph[row.library].add(name)
        od
    od

    return graph
si

compile_order(graph: MAP[string, SET[string]])
    -> (ordered: List[string], blocked: List[string])
is
    let pending = MAP[string, SET[string]]()

    for name in graph.keys do
        pending[name] = SET(graph[name])
    od

    let ordered = LIST()

    do
        let ready = pending.keys
            |> filter(name => pending[name].count == 0)
            |> sort((left, right) => left <> right)
            |> collect()

        if ready.count == 0 then
            break
        fi

        for name in ready do
            ordered.add(name)
            pending.remove(name)
        od

        for name in pending.keys |> collect() do
            for done in ready do
                pending[name].remove(done)
            od
        od
    od

    let blocked = pending.keys |> sort((left, right) => left <> right) |> collect()

    return (ordered = ordered, blocked = blocked)
si

report(heading: string, rows: List[ROW]) is
    let (ordered, blocked) = compile_order(dependency_graph(rows))

    write_line(heading)
    write_line("    compile order: {ordered |> join(" ")}")

    if blocked.count > 0 then
        write_line("    unorderable:   {blocked |> join(" ")}")
    fi
si

let libraries = [
    (library = "des_system_lib",
        dependencies = "std synopsys std_cell_lib des_system_lib dw02 dw01 ramlib ieee"),
    (library = "dw01", dependencies = "ieee dw01 dware gtech"),
    (library = "dw02", dependencies = "ieee dw02 dware"),
    (library = "dw03",
        dependencies = "std synopsys dware dw03 dw02 dw01 ieee gtech"),
    (library = "dw04", dependencies = "dw04 ieee dw01 dware gtech"),
    (library = "dw05", dependencies = "dw05 ieee dware"),
    (library = "dw06", dependencies = "dw06 ieee dware"),
    (library = "dw07", dependencies = "ieee dware"),
    (library = "dware", dependencies = "ieee dware"),
    (library = "gtech", dependencies = "ieee gtech"),
    (library = "ramlib", dependencies = "std ieee"),
    (library = "std_cell_lib", dependencies = "ieee std_cell_lib"),
    (library = "synopsys", dependencies = "")
]

let with_cycle = libraries
    |> map(row =>
        if row.library =~ "dw01" then
            (library = row.library, dependencies = "{row.dependencies} dw04")
        else
            row
        fi)
    |> collect()

report("as given:", libraries)
write_line("")
report("with dw04 added to the dependencies of dw01:", with_cycle)
